stop_one_pidfile() {
    local name="$1"
    local pid_file="$2"
    if [[ ! -f "${pid_file}" ]]; then
        return 0
    fi
    local pid
    pid="$(cat "${pid_file}" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ -n "${pid}" ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "[STOP] Stopping ${name} (PID: ${pid})..."
        kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
        local waited=0
        while kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null && [[ "${waited}" -lt 25 ]]; do
            sleep 0.1
            waited=$((waited + 1))
        done
        if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
            kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    fi
    rm -f "${pid_file}"
}

stop_services_internal() {
    local log_dir="${AISOC_LOG_DIR}"
    stop_one_pidfile "ui-gateway" "${log_dir}/ui_gateway.pid"
    stop_one_pidfile "device_manager_daemon" "${log_dir}/device_manager.pid"
    stop_one_pidfile "forward_service_daemon" "${log_dir}/forward.pid"
    stop_one_pidfile "dbus-daemon" "${log_dir}/dbus.pid"
    rm -f "${log_dir}/dbus.addr" "${log_dir}/runtime.env"
}
